name: kpopper
description: An epistemic record for work that gets revisited: what is known, how each piece is grounded, and what would make each judgment wrong. Self-evolving — judgments re-check against their dependencies and surface what drifted, so staleness is derived rather than remembered. Ships a reader, a checker, and a two-tab HTML page with a provenance layer: the arrangement this session chose, and the record itself.

interface.shortDescription: Keep sources, judgments, and important changes together.
